memory_candidates.content: When running an oracle/bimodal_logic/tests/ fast gate, always include 'and not development' in the -m expression -- oracle/conftest.py's pytest_collection_modifyitems applies a tree-level development marker blanket to every oracle test except the six differential/soundness-core classes, and omitting the filter surfaces expected, tracked bimodal-construction failures as if they were regressions.
